user.title: Find your school
user.description: Log in with the same credentials you use on sdui.app. Parent accounts can add all children at once.

data_description.school: Name, city or slink of the school (at least 3 characters). The address of the school's login page works too.

students.title: Students
students.description: Choose the students whose timetable should be shown. Each student gets an own device with sensors and calendar. If a child is missing, enter its timetable id (number in the address of its timetable on sdui.app, after timetable/users/); several ids separated by commas.

reauth_confirm.title: Sdui re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: The login for {account} is no longer valid. Enter your Sdui credentials.

data_description.slink: Slink of your school: the part after sdui.app/ in the address of its login page, e.g. my-school. Search your school at {school_search} – the address of the page you land on contains the slink. The full address works too.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check school, username and password.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Sdui or school not found. Details in the Home Assistant log.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
error.invalid_student: No access to the timetable of an entered id. Check the id.
error.school_not_found: No school found. Try another part of the name or the city.

abort.already_configured: This Sdui account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different Sdui account.
